name: Nutrient MCP
description: Extracts fields, parses to Markdown, classifies, converts, signs and redacts PDFs and documents for AI agents through Nutrient's hosted MCP server.

skills.name: Extract Document Fields
skills.description: Extracts the fields you describe in plain words from invoices, claims and other documents, with citations and confidence.

skills.name: Parse to Markdown
skills.description: Turns PDFs, scans and images into Markdown and tables that an agent can read and reason over.

skills.name: Classify Documents
skills.description: Sorts documents by type, such as invoice, contract or claim, so an agent can route them to the right workflow.

skills.name: Convert and Edit PDFs
skills.description: Converts Office files to PDF, runs OCR, merges, rotates and watermarks pages, and creates PDF/A or PDF/UA files.

skills.name: Sign and Redact
skills.description: Adds a digital signature to a PDF, or finds and removes personal data with AI-assisted redaction.
